dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing from the anterior-most visible section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor asymmetrical deviations along the left lateral margin; right margin remains relatively linear.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median intensity.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse grey patches primarily concentrated on the left lateral-dorsal region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between light grey and off-white skin tones.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple fine, longitudinal, light-colored linear marks (consistent with rake marks) on the dorsal surface, including one prominent line on the left-central axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear scratches and rake marks distributed across the dorsal plane.
